summary_1line: Narada warns against pride and obstinacy, and Krishna urges Duryodhana to heed wise counsel and make peace with the Pandavas.

image_candidates.scene_text: Krishna stands before the defiant Duryodhana in the Kuru court, calmly advising peace while elders like Bhishma and Vidura look on.
The celestial sage Narada recounts the fall of King Yayati, who once ruled gloriously but was cast down from heaven by his pride.
